product_one_liner.value: Paddle is an all-in-one payments and billing merchant of record for modern SaaS, mobile app, AI, and digital-product companies.
product_one_liner.notes: Paddle's developer documentation describes it as an all-in-one payments and billing merchant of record for modern SaaS, mobile app, AI, and digital-product companies.

pricing_page.notes: Paddle's public pricing page lists its pay-as-you-go offering and transaction price.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Paddle's enterprise page names Sony, P&G, and ServiceNow as customers it is trusted by. | named_customers.0: The enterprise page explicitly names Sony. | named_customers.1: The enterprise page explicitly names P&G. | named_customers.2: The enterprise page explicitly names ServiceNow.

employee_band.notes: The employee directory source states that Paddle employs between 201 and 500 people.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile gives Paddle's location as London, England, United Kingdom; the city is London. | hq_country: The company profile identifies Paddle's location as London, England, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: The Paddle portfolio page explicitly gives its founding year as 2012.

eng_blog.notes: Paddle.engineering's index lists at least two engineering-focused posts, including one on its design system and one on Go microservices, with named authors and dates.

public_docs.notes: Paddle's public developer site describes documentation covering its API, SDKs, webhooks, Paddle.js, and an API reference with separate articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Paddle's careers page lists an open Head of Data Science role, which qualifies as an AI/ML/data-science role under the stated criteria.

model_provider.notes: Paddle's AI announcement and developer docs describe agent integrations or benchmarked models, not a model provider used by Paddle's product. The Trust Center identifies Dust as providing AI tooling and workflow processing but does not name a model provider. No provider was publicly identified in the materials checked.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Paddle's Trust Center lists SOC 2, PCI DSS 4.0.1, and GDPR under compliance; these are the listed items from the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center names SOC 2 under compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center names PCI DSS 4.0.1 under compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center names GDPR under compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding history identifies Paddle's latest round as a $25.0M debt round in July 2025; a separate funding report labels it Debt Financing. | funding_date: Paddle's announcement dates the $25M financing to July 17, 2025, and the funding history identifies July 2025 as the latest round's month. | funding_amount_usd: Paddle's announcement states that it raised $25M in July 2025; the funding history identifies that $25.0M debt round as its latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: Paddle announced the $25M financing on July 17, 2025. That date is within the 18 months before 2026-11-09, so Paddle raised funding in the period.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Paddle's careers page lists a live Senior Account Executive opening in San Francisco.

launched_6mo.notes: Paddle announced the AI Toolkit launch on October 20, 2026, which falls within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lesley Warner's profile identifies her as Paddle's VP of Revenue Operations and lists her Paddle role start date as 2026-10-01, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Paddle job posts explicitly mention HubSpot and Salesforce in the buyer-journey stack and name Dreamdata in the marketing technology stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job post explicitly names HubSpot in Paddle's buyer-journey reporting stack. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job post explicitly names Salesforce in Paddle's buyer-journey reporting stack. | crm_stack_signal.2: The marketing operations job post names Dreamdata as part of Paddle's marketing technology stack.
